Personal Google Drive access

rcclone · Maintained by Eduardo Mena

rcclone is my personal Google OAuth application for using the open-source rclone tool with my own Google Drive account.

It lets me access my Drive files as a mounted folder on my computer and manage them with rclone. This application is for my personal use.

How it works

Google sign-in authorizes the installed rclone application to connect to my Google Drive. Rclone runs on my computer and sends file-management requests directly to Google's services.

The Google Drive permission allows rclone to list, read, download, create, update, and delete files as needed for the operations I choose. Opening and editing files in the mounted folder can download local copies and upload changes to Drive.

Privacy and control

These web pages provide information about the application. They do not receive Drive files or Google OAuth credentials. See the privacy policy for details about access, local storage, and revoking permission.

Google access can be revoked through Google Account connections.

Contact
